response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, senior full-stack and systems developer with strong open-source, testing, and mentoring credentials, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks 8 years of C++ programming experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments and a bachelor's thesis project), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed infrastructure leadership experience, and his career is centered on web/product engineering (Node.js, TypeScript, DLang) rather than cloud compute architecture.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and open-source project leadership
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks)
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (only ~1.5 years at National Instruments), far short of the 8-year requirement
No evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform, distributed systems at scale, or hardware/storage architecture work
No formal technical leadership title or experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers in a platform organization

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform / distributed infrastructure leadership
Strong general engineering seniority and mentoring background
